clauses.clause: Attacks hit civilians, soldiers, staff and animals; animals turn in 2.5–3.5 s keeping id/species; 3–5 Alphas over the run; concurrent ≤ 200 / 100.
clauses.note: Current-source complete/stationary native outbreak routes at both qualities match independent canonical final-state hashes. All four victim classes receive actual bites/damage across native routes and explicit local-threat fixtures. Five species each retain ID/species and turn after actual first successful bites within2.5–3.5s (fresh animal range2.533333–3.25s). Full competent routes admit5 Alphas each and all measured concurrency remains<=100/200; local fixtures peak77/144. Local fixtures spawn four ordinary runners around existing healthy targets after ordinary3600tick breach, no target HP/AI/faction/cap changes; courier only protected. They establish bite capability rather than natural coverage of every species. Six temporary evidence faults are rejected by actual evaluator and original bytes restored. No game/checker/target changes.
